label: PF Backlog 557
title: CI/CD model + read API for orchestrator/UI (single projection of gates/tiers/triggers)
body:
## Problem / why
CI/CD + gates detail lives in several owners (engineering-flow.json, validation-profiles.json, test-matrix.json,
pipeline-definition.json, precheck.py, pr_gate.py) with no single read API for the orchestrator/UI.

## Goal & value
One read-only projection so the dashboard/orchestrator can render CI/CD + gate status.
- `core/ci_cd_model.py` (new): reads existing owners; NEVER a second truth (no duplicated status).
- `api/routers/engineering.py`: `GET /api/v1/engineering/ci-cd`, `/ci-cd/{scope}` (product_forge|project:<id>),
  `/gates` (catalog + last run verdict/evidence).

## Acceptance
- Endpoints return the model (tiers x gates x triggers x owners) + per-scope effective pipeline.
- Reads only; no writes; registered in store-registry if it persists anything; wired + tested.
